answer: Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through an ocean debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the sable totals, and the falcon anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 44 units per epoch, sustaining 234 aliases for 29 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the farming party. That is 2 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
